what_worked.description: Centralizing taxonomy and contract specifications into skill-organizer eliminates copy-paste drift across skills
Decoupling prompts into prompt_contract.json enables identical machine execution across ComfyUI, n8n, and CLI tools

what_failed.failure_mode: Fragmented txt files (e.g., tryon-user-prompt.txt vs virtual tryon.txt)
what_failed.root_cause: Ad-hoc txt files lack parameter definitions, schema validation, and dynamic variable definitions
what_failed.drift_vector: Broken ComfyUI text nodes and unlinked pipelines

what_to_adapt.rule_addition: Enforce single unified prompt_contract.json per skill; deprecate scattered txt files
